hero.heading: Who can tell it’s yours?
vault.private_hint: Wallets nobody should be able to tie to you.
vault.public_hint: Wallets tied to your identity: KYC exchange withdrawals, addresses you shared.
assets.heading: The whole stash
assets.empty: No balances yet: sync your wallets.
assets.start: Add your wallets under “{{tab}}” to start.
wallets.heading: Apparently, they talk
wallets.hint: Each card says whether the wallet can be tied to your other wallets, and where its funds came from. Open one for the evidence.
groups.heading: What an observer sees
groups.hint: Wallets tied by links of 50% or more look like one person to anyone who reads the chains, whichever chains they are on. Open a group for the links that hold it together.
groups.none: No two of your wallets are tied at 50% or more. Weaker guesses are in each wallet’s verdict, and this is not proof of privacy.
groups.public_one: Includes your public wallet {{names}}: anyone who knows it can tie the others to you
groups.public_other: Includes your public wallets {{names}}: anyone who knows one can tie the others to you
groups.private: No public wallet in it, but to an observer these wallets are one person
groups.partial: Partly checked: not every wallet in it was read in full, so the group may be larger.
groups.links: What holds it together, weakest first
groups.alone: This link alone holds the group together: without it, {{a}} and {{b}} are apart.
card.unchecked: Not checked, so its value is unknown
verdict.unchecked: Not checked yet: sync this wallet
verdict.unchecked_failed: Not checked: the last sync failed
verdict.clean: No link to your other wallets found
verdict.partial_filling: Partly checked: history still filling in
verdict.partial_filling_back: Partly checked: history still filling in, back to {{date}} so far
verdict.partial_errors: Partly checked: the last sync had errors
verdict.weak_public: Weak guess: may be tied to public wallet {{name}} ({{pct}})
verdict.weak_private: Weak guess: may be tied to private wallet {{name}} ({{pct}})
verdict.tied_one: Tied to {{count}} other wallet of yours
verdict.tied_other: Tied to {{count}} other wallets of yours
caveat.error: The last sync of this wallet had errors ({{error}}), so its history may be incomplete.
caveat.filling: Links in its older transactions are not seen yet: every sync reads further back until its history is complete.
caveat.truncated: This wallet is very active and only its newest transactions are loaded. Older links are not seen.
caveat.unexpanded_one: {{left}} of its {{count}} unlabelled counterparty has not been expanded. A link that runs through two or more strangers can hide there: sync deeper, or expand it in the graph.
caveat.unexpanded_other: {{left}} of its {{count}} unlabelled counterparties have not been expanded. A link that runs through two or more strangers can hide there: sync deeper, or expand them in the graph.
caveat.shared: Both this wallet and {{name}} used {{services}}. The chain does not link them, but that service can.
caveat.bridged: It bridged to {{address}} on {{chain}} through {{protocol}}. The bridge's public record ties that address to this wallet: if it is yours, add it as a wallet.
caveat.bridged_busy: It bridged to {{address}} on {{chain}} through {{protocol}}. That address is very active or a service, so it links no other wallet here, but the bridge's public record still shows the transfer.
caveat.bridged_closed: It bridged to a Solana token account through {{protocol}} ({{address}}). That account has been closed since, so its owner can no longer be read and it links no wallet here.
caveat.exchange: It dealt directly with {{names}}. If that account is in your name, the exchange knows this wallet is yours: consider marking it public.
caveat.mixer: It dealt with a mixer. Funds past a mixer cannot be followed here.
caveat.hops_one: Paths longer than {{count}} hop are not searched.
caveat.hops_other: Paths longer than {{count}} hops are not searched.
caveat.invisible: Swaps outside THORChain and Maya, chains that are not read, unlabelled exchange wallets and anything off-chain (same IP address, same exchange account) are invisible to this check.
origin.heading: Origin of {{asset}} in {{name}}
origin.rest: {{pct}} from smaller sources not listed (the empty end of the bar)
wallet.name: Name
wallet.tied: Can it be tied to your other wallets?
wallet.missed: What this check may still have missed
wallet.not_proof: This is not proof of privacy
wallet.origins_hint: Followed back to a labelled source, one of your wallets, or the edge of what is known. Shares are an estimate: an address that forwards money passes on its own sources in proportion.
